details: The Federal Reserve maintained its benchmark interest rate within the 3.5%-3.75% range, marking the fourth consecutive meeting without a change. The decision was notable for exhibiting the most dissenting votes since 1992, with some policymakers advocating for a rate cut while others opposed any language suggesting future easing. The central bank cited persistent elevated inflation, partly attributed to rising global energy prices stemming from the Middle East conflict, as a key factor contributing to a "high level of uncertainty about the economic outlook." This meeting also marked Jerome Powell's final one as Fed Chair, though he indicated his intention to remain on the Board of Governors.
title: Federal Reserve Holds Rates Steady Amid Dissent and Geopolitical Concerns

details: Bitcoin and other major cryptocurrencies experienced a decline, with Bitcoin briefly falling below $75,000, immediately following the Federal Reserve's announcement to hold interest rates steady. The crypto market's reaction suggests that investors were anticipating a more dovish signal from the Fed. The split vote among the Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) members and the central bank's acknowledgment of elevated inflation driven by rising global energy prices and developments in the Middle East contributed to increased market uncertainty, thereby cooling expectations for any near-term rate cuts.
title: Bitcoin Slips Below $76k Following Fed's Divided Rate Decision
